notes: Piece P2 (Presidio north). Box moved from x0 1220 to 1240 (w 690 to 670) so the left side cuts across the ramp lines instead of running along the near-parallel lines at x 1205-1240, y 1240-1600; other sides as given. Judgment calls (page px): (1) The bay above the shoreline (1405,1000)-(1910,1095) joins the land through the ink: one open area with it. (2) Doyle Dr band (from y 1233-1275 at x 1240 to y 1350-1370 at x 1910) is 18-26 px wide, wider than the 8-11 px roads, but it is the through road lettered DOYLE DR east of the box (about 2400,1270): street. (3) The band just south of Doyle, 16-23 px, is a lens closed by points at both ends: (1504,1329) and, east of the box, about (2001,1347) where it meets Doyle's line (checked on the page; the P3 piece marks it open). It is land. Its ink joins the land west of McDowell and the lens at (1400-1500,1290-1330), so all are one open area (seed 1337,1309). Under it the 5-8 px band from (1500,1340) to the box side is Lincoln Blvd (lettered LINCOLN BLVD east of the box, about 2100-2200,1400-1460): street. (4) Triangle (1470-1560,1350-1445) enclosed by a road that loops back on itself: open; the 4 px gap in its outline at (1502-1506,1349) closed with a stroke. (5) Area around the rounded outline (1760-1795,1528-1550) and the triangle (1735-1785,1552-1590), reached from the road at (1770-1830,1440-1700) through a 10 px mouth at (1800-1812,1542-1553): marked street as a turnaround or lot; its open ends into the land closed with limits at the top of the 5 px channel between lines x 1745 and 1751 (y 1503), between the stub and the triangle (1739,1553)-(1734,1566), and between the triangle and the line end (1758,1587)-(1758,1598). It could instead be land with two building outlines: owner to rule. The rounded outline is open; the triangle's ink touches the land at its corners, so it is part of the big land's area. (6) Two lines rising from the road bend at (1250,1595), 3 px apart there and 30 px apart at their open ends (1225,1526) and (1255,1519): marked as a path (street) with a limit across the open end; it could be a land wedge. (7) Strokes close print gaps: the nose where Mason St and the on-ramp part (1357-1359,1213 and 1348,1224-1227), Mason St's south line (1815,1252); and one traced on Doyle's north line across the on-ramp mouth (1358,1262)-(1378,1268) so the land at (1272,1216) and the strip between Mason and Doyle stay apart. (8) Teardrop outline in Mason St (1410-1478,1215-1235): open (traffic island). Small ring in a path eye (1505-1517,1690-1700) and the solid speck in the path eye at (1508,1549): open (islands in a path), doubtful. (9) MASON letters touching Mason St's north line (1835-1875,1240-1250) count as land (tool limit); McDOWELL AVE letters stay street. The hook road (1520-1800,1300-1370) curls into an S; its slot is road. (10) Closed outlines between roads at the Main Post edge (U at 1812-1848,1530-1600; parallelogram 1830-1860,1450-1520; blocks at the right and bottom sides): open. A 2 px sliver at (1909,1579) on the right side is left as street.
